essence: True knowledge of the supreme form confers the highest spiritual identity and qualities.
The spiritual excellence of the knower sanctifies both his descendants and his associates.
Speaking with this knower brings merit greater than that of a great royal sacrifice.
The presence or influence of such a knower brings collective well-being and security.
The text maps specific divine functions to specific directional positions.
